abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, so the counters were never placed. 'Enters the arena with N counters' happens ONCE, when it enters -- an ON_ENTER_PLAY trigger, not a continuous static, which would have kept adding counters had it run at all.

Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. The class filter was authored under 'class', which ATTACK_CLASS_IN does not read, and it belonged to the ATTACK rather than the defender in any case.
